about: Track Solo 0.2 for Digitakt OS 1.54: the author's released .elemod file, pinned unchanged.

mods.title: Track Solo
mods.summary: Ten Digitakt MKI mods: new LFO waves with pictures, a looping random LFO, Kit A/B, Ctrl All, real units, mute snapshots, track solo, velocity humanise and Euclidean accents.
mods.description: Track Solo, after the Octatrack mod: hold TRK, then hold UP, and the active track plays alone until you let go of UP; TRK + DOWN latches the solo (again to unlatch, or on another track to move it). The other tracks' note trigs simply don't fire, so sounding notes ring out and the stock mutes are never touched. S and the track number show in the top-right corner. Needs seq-events.
mods.author: Cere, made with Claude
mods.on_unit: All ten tested together on a real Digitakt MKI (OS 1.54) with core and seq-events: LFO waves and pictures, Deja Vu loops and destinations, Kit A/B, Ctrl All, real-unit displays, mute snapshots, track solo, humanise, Euclid accents and the MOD SETTINGS row. OS 1.53 not supported.
